name: Alps
source:
Mercenary admiral hired through the Pluepet Trade Firm. Working hard to raise money for her sick mother and younger brothers. Before now in the eight post offices from across of world some clerks told her to marry their sons. Likes traditional mail and post marks.

"I-I'll do my best... Your elder sister will do her best."
